actions.name: post_status
actions.description: Post a status to Mastodon, optionally as a reply, with a content warning or with limited visibility.

actions.name: schedule_status
actions.description: Schedule a status to be published automatically at a future time.

actions.name: get_status
actions.description: Get a single status by its ID.

actions.name: edit_status
actions.description: Edit the text, content warning, media or poll of one of your statuses.

actions.name: delete_status
actions.description: Permanently delete one of your own statuses.

actions.name: favourite_status
actions.description: Add a status to your favourites.

actions.name: boost_status
actions.description: Boost (reblog) a status to your followers.

actions.name: upload_media
actions.description: Upload an image, video or audio file, then map its Media ID into Media IDs of Post Status, Schedule Status or Edit Status to attach it.

actions.name: lookup_account
actions.description: Find an account by its handle (username or user@domain) to get its Account ID for Follow Account and other steps.

actions.name: follow_account
actions.description: Follow an account, or send a follow request to a locked account.

actions.name: get_hashtag_timeline
actions.description: Get recent public statuses that use a hashtag.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search for accounts, statuses and hashtags.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_mention
triggers.description: Triggers when someone mentions your account in a post, including replies and direct messages. On mastodon.social and other servers running Mastodon 4.3 or later, direct messages and mentions from accounts you do not follow may be held back by your notification filters (Preferences > Notifications) and will not trigger the flow until you accept them.

triggers.name: new_follower
triggers.description: Triggers when someone starts following your account. If your account requires follow approval, people appear here only after you accept their request.

triggers.name: new_status_from_account
triggers.description: Triggers when a specific account publishes a new post. For accounts on other servers, only posts that reach your server are seen, so following the account makes this reliable.

triggers.name: new_status_with_hashtag
triggers.description: Triggers when a new public post uses a hashtag. Posts from other servers are included once they reach your server.
